cli.intro: open-panel — local ops panel for services, sites, processes, and logs. One installable with `gui` (desktop client) and `serve` (WebUI).

cmd.capabilities: Report domain capabilities and their availability
cmd.audit: Read audit records for the current actor
cmd.gui: Open the desktop client GUI and pump host events until it closes
cmd.serve: Start the local WebUI listener for browser access

opt.actor: Audit actor id (user or agent name)
opt.actor-source: Audit actor source (cli, skill, gui, serve, ...)
opt.content-dir: Directory containing the staged panel UI build
opt.title: Desktop window title
opt.kind: Filter audit records by actor kind
opt.id: Filter audit records by actor id
opt.capability: Filter audit records by capability id
